scan.title: Scan this code on the panel
scan.description: On the panel, open Settings and tap **Scan QR code**. If it cannot read it, type the address `{url}` and the code `{code}`. The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Press Submit when the panel says it is connected.

error.not_scanned: The panel has not used the code yet. If it expired, this is a new one.

abort.already_configured: This panel already exists: remove it first to add it again.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no internal URL: set one in Settings > System > Network.

intercoms.title: Intercoms
intercoms.description: The panel registers with them over SIP, to answer the door and talk to it. DMSS is not affected. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.intercoms: Choose the doorbell button of each intercom to make the panel ring when it is pressed. With the intercom's RTSP URL, with its user and password, its video shows as soon as it rings, and the sound and the panel's voice go over RTSP: SIP only tells it someone answered; the button to press when a panel answers stops its other calls, such as the VTO's Cancel Call. For a Dahua VTO: rtsp://admin:PASSWORD@ADDRESS/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Their video is shown in the panel's menu. You can leave the list empty.

data_description.cameras: If you have intercoms, choose one to offer Talk on that camera.

display.title: Readings and charts
display.description: Readings are shown under the time, with the value and unit of their entity. Each chart gets a button in the panel's menu, with the next 24 hours. You can leave the lists empty.

data_description.readings: Any entity, such as the car's battery. Its value turns yellow when it crosses a warning.
data_description.charts: An entity with the values by the hour in its raw_today and raw_tomorrow attributes, as lists of start and value: the format of Nord Pool, ENTSO-e or EV Smart Charging, for example for the electricity price. The cheapest hours stand out.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: The weather and the forecast next to the clock.

init.title: Panel settings
init.description: Open what you want to change. Submitting a page saves it, and the panel applies it right away.

entities.title: Sensors, siren and speaker
entities.description: What this panel exposes in Home Assistant.

data_description.sensors: Light, battery and its temperature, overheating, charging, Wi-Fi signal, app version and presence, guessed from sudden changes of light. Off: Home Assistant removes those entities.
data_description.siren: Lets Home Assistant sound the panel's siren at full volume. Off: it silences the panel and removes the entity.
data_description.speaker: A media player for tts.speak and any other audio. Off: it stops the audio and removes the entity.

rtsp.title: Publish the camera
rtsp.description: Creates a camera entity in Home Assistant. The panel's camera is only on while something is watching, and the panel shows it and keeps its screen on: Frigate or anything that records keeps it on all the time. Anyone on the home network who has the password can see it. Others, such as Frigate, connect to `{url}`, so give the panel a fixed address.

data_description.rtsp_password: At least 12 characters, or empty to generate one. The user is always marc2d.
data_description.rtsp_audio: Also sends the panel's microphone: whoever watches can hear the room. The droid's eye shows it. Check the law where you live before recording conversations.

voice.title: Voice commands
voice.description: The panel listens for its wake phrase on the device. Only what follows is sent to Home Assistant. It downloads a 40 MB model the first time, and anyone near the panel can give orders to what is exposed to Assist.

data_description.pipeline: Needs speech-to-text. Empty uses the preferred assistant.
data_description.wake_phrase: Say it alone, with a pause before and after. Short, unusual phrases work best. It has to use words of the panel's Spanish model: with any other word it never reacts. Empty uses jarvis.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: A screensaver: when nobody touches the panel for a while, its photos take the place of the clock, until someone touches it again. They only show while the droid has nothing to say: an alarm, the camera, a voice command, a warning or a dark room keep the clock. The photos come from a Home Assistant media source, so the panel needs no other credentials. Android still turns the screen off after its own screen timeout, unless you keep it on below.

data.photos_match_orientation: Only photos shaped like the screen

data_description.photos_folder: A folder of My media, such as photos for /media/photos. For any other source, such as an Immich album or another media folder, open it in Media, in the sidebar, and paste the browser's address here, or its media-source:// identifier. It is checked when you save.
data_description.photos_subfolders: Also shows the photos in its subfolders, and theirs. At most 2000 photos in 200 folders.
data_description.photos_idle_minutes: How long the clock stays before the photos start.
data_description.photos_order: Shuffled again on each pass, or by name.
data_description.photos_fit: Whole photo, with black bars where it does not fill the screen, or cropped to fill it.
data_description.photos_match_orientation: With the panel in landscape, only landscape photos, and in portrait only portrait ones; square photos show either way. The panel learns each photo's shape the first time it downloads it, and from then on skips the others without downloading them. If none matches, it shows them all.
data_description.photos_clock: The time and the date, small, in a corner of the photos.
data_description.photos_keep_screen_on: While the photos show, Android does not turn the screen off: it stays on until the room goes dark or someone touches it. It uses more power and wears the OLED screen sooner.

error.too_short: At least 12 characters: anyone on the home network can try it. Leave it empty to generate one.
error.folder_not_found: Home Assistant cannot open this folder. Check that it exists under Media, as a folder of My media or a media-source:// identifier.
error.no_photos: There are no photos in this folder. Add some, or include its subfolders.
